foils.nl: Extend downward the column that contains the most 8s (ties broken by leftmost).
foils.code:
def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R=len(g); C=len(g[0])
    best=-1; bc=-1
    for c in range(C):
        cnt=sum(1 for r in range(R) if g[r][c]==8)
        if cnt>best: best=cnt; bc=c
    if bc<0 or best<=0: return g
    low=max(r for r in range(R) if g[r][bc]==8)
    for r in range(low,R): g[r][bc]=8
    return g
